subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can use Unit 1 words: personality adjectives and hobbies.
I can use comparatives, superlatives and be good at + verb-ing correctly.
I can answer exam-style questions about appearance, personality and abilities.

tf.s: If you don't do any work, you are lazy.
tf.why: Yes! Lazy people don't like to work.

tf.s: "That boy is the most mean boy in the school" is correct.
The opposite of polite is rude.
tf.why: Right! Polite and rude are opposites.

tf.s: "He is good at doing experiments" is correct.
"My sister is tidyer than I am" is spelled correctly.
"He likes making pizza" answers "What's he like?"
tf.why: What's he like? needs personality, like He's very polite.

tf.s: An exam tip: read each word to see which one fits best.
tf.why: Yes! This helps you choose the right answer.

tf.s: "He's tall with long, black, curly hair" answers "What does he look like?"
The superlative of short is the most short.
tf.why: Short is a short adjective: the shortest.

tf.s: We say "I'm good at fix toys."
tf.why: We say I'm good at fixing toys.

boxes.q: My brother always says ___ and thank you.
boxes.why: Please and thank you are polite words.

boxes.q: My sister is ___ than I am. (tidy)
He is shorter than me, but he is not the ___ person in our family.
My toy is broken! But I'm ___ fixing toys!

o: He's very polite and he seems very confident.
boxes.why: What's he like? asks about personality.

boxes.q: Which word is a hobby phrase?
boxes.why: Bake a cake is a hobby.

boxes.q: What are you like? Choose a good answer.
boxes.why: What are you like? needs personality adjectives.

mcq.q: Which two things are Unit 1 vocabulary?
mcq.why: Unit 1 words are personality adjectives and hobbies.

mcq.q: Which sentence helps you check your progress?
o: Now I can … / I need to work more on …

mcq.q: Write about your avatar's appearance and personality. Which is best?
o: My avatar has got short, curly hair. She's confident and hard-working.
My avatar is good at bake.
My avatar has got kind hair.
My avatar is the most tall.
mcq.why: It has appearance and personality, with correct grammar.

mcq.q: Ali is 12, Sara is 10 and Huda is 8. Which sentence is correct?
mcq.why: 12 is the biggest age, so Ali is the oldest.

mcq.q: Choose: Basil is the ___ boy in the class at football. He never wins. (bad)
Why is "He's tall with long, black, curly hair" the best answer to "What does he look like?"
Find the mistake: "She's more kind than her brother."
Your friend always does all her homework and helps at home. Which adjective fits her best?
mcq.why: She works a lot, so she is hard-working.
